professional_summary: Software Engineer with experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services, API integrations, and workflow automation across e-commerce and insurance domains. Expertise in JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, REST APIs, and GraphQL. Skilled in owning complex features, resolving high-impact production issues, improving application performance, mentoring developers, and leveraging LLM-assisted development.

responsibilities.text: Delivered 3 insurance products across the US and Canada on InsureMO platform, owning product configuration, form development, custom insurance APIs, and backend integrations.

Engineered JEXL-driven form logic and API orchestration for proposal cancellation, policy issuance, custom endorsements, and policy/proposal number generation; automated Forms uploads through scripting. Resolved a critical print-service validation error affecting 600+ form configurations.
Served as an InsureMO Forms and Product Build SME, leading complex form configurations, attachment logic, and data mapping while mentoring new developers.
Resolved 139 defects across the Ryan Specialty Underwriting Managers platform, predominantly Critical/High severity. Developed data workflows and UI modules for Coverages and Additional Interests
Collaborated with Unqork engineers on Vega 2.0 runtime POCs, contributing to 4 new components and reusable server-side pagination module.
Developed a Shopify application for furniture retailers, allowing personalized order creation across POS and Admin using specific workflows and attributes.
Built a custom collection management application with configurable rule-based conditions, metafield filters, and logical operators (AND/OR, contains, starts-with).

Developed a Shopify POS application supporting on-account orders and receipt printing, integrating QuickBooks Desktop synchronization through its SOAP API. Modernized the legacy app by migrating Admin REST integrations to GraphQL and replacing deprecated operations, achieving a 100% reduction in API deprecation errors.

Designed a reusable Shopify image-picker modal adopted across internal products; leveraged Shopify’s media transformations to serve optimized WebP thumbnails, reducing list-view image loading time by 50%.
metrics: reducing list-view image loading time by 50%

responsibilities.text: Integrated Web3 wallet connectivity into a Shopify storefront using WalletConnect SDK, supporting QR-code authentication on web and deep-link connections on mobile; optimized performance and accessibility, achieving Lighthouse scores above 90.
Transformed Lovable prototypes into production-ready Shopify applications, developing backend APIs and reusable UI components aligned with Shopify Polaris.
metrics: Lovable prototypes into production-ready Shopify applications

responsibilities.text: Delivered a Frappe ERP MVP embedded in Shopify Admin, implementing authentication, integration workflows, and automatic synchronization of changes between both platforms.
metrics: ERP MVP embedded in Shopify Admin

responsibilities.text: Collaborated with developers in an Agile environment, contributing to sprint planning, task execution, and delivery of full-stack features using Node.js, React, MongoDB, and DynamoDB.
